purpose.text: Run one catalog search using the supplied request, preserving the supplied values and the omission of missing optional arguments. Record the search response's total in local count.txt and return its items exactly as received.

evidences.reason: The skill description identifies a single query driven by a supplied request and preservation of optional-argument semantics.
This line specifies the local output for the search response's total.
This line identifies the returned value and requires preserving it exactly.

requirements.text: Read the user-supplied request.json, which contains term and may contain from_date and limit.

evidences.reason: This line identifies the input to read and the required and optional members of the request.

requirements.text: Call index.search exactly once in the workflow.

evidences.reason: This line names the required operation and fixes its invocation count.

requirements.text: Use the exact value of request.term as the query argument of that index.search call.

evidences.reason: This line maps the original request term directly to the query argument.

requirements.text: When from_date is present in request.json, pass its exact value as the from_date argument of that index.search call. The accepted argument format is YYYY-MM-DD.

evidences.reason: This line specifies the presence condition, preservation of the supplied date value, and the accepted format.
This line scopes the parameter description to the call and rules out interpreting it as an instruction to validate or normalize before the call.

requirements.text: When from_date is missing from request.json, apply the configured omission of the from_date argument to that index.search call.

evidences.reason: This line specifies omission of the argument when the request lacks from_date.
This line makes the query configuration's missing-argument settings applicable to the same search call.
These lines give the configured omission behavior for a missing from_date.

requirements.text: When limit is present in request.json, pass its exact value as the limit argument of that index.search call.

evidences.reason: This line specifies the presence condition, target argument, and preservation of the supplied limit value.

requirements.text: When limit is missing from request.json, apply the configured omission of the limit argument to that index.search call.

evidences.reason: This line specifies omission of the argument when the request lacks limit.
This line makes the query configuration's missing-argument settings applicable to the same search call.
This span places the limit omission setting under the missing-argument configuration.

requirements.text: Never invoke index.delete during the workflow.

evidences.reason: This line explicitly prohibits the operation throughout the workflow.

requirements.text: After the search, write the total value from that search response to local count.txt.

evidences.reason: This line specifies the ordering, source value, and local destination of the write.

requirements.text: Return the items value from that search response exactly as received.

evidences.reason: This line selects the items value from the search response and requires its exact preservation.
